title: Accordion
purpose: Collapsible content: stacked details (default), two-column FAQ bars, icon tiles revealing lists, sidebar link tree.
variantOption: classes (select): variant; legacy block classes (<legacy>, -wrapper, -container) are added by scripts/variants.js

visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ question bars (#f0f0f0, plus/minus icon on the left) split into two columns; each item expands independently with an animated height
visualCharacteristics.description: No accordion variant fits: accordion-icon-grid is centered icon tiles with a shared toggle; cards-faq is static. This is a two-column list of full-width grey question bars with a left plus/minus icon, each toggling independently.

contentPattern.summary: 8 question bars (#f0f0f0, plus icon left) in two columns of 4; each bar independently expands its answer
contentPattern.structure: one row per question: (1) question text (`summary`); (2) answer rich text (`text`). The block puts the first half of the rows in the left column

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for collapsible FAQs. For always-open Q&A boxes use cards-faq.
variants.usageDescription: FAQ question bars (#f0f0f0, plus/minus icon on the left) split into two columns; each item expands independently with an animated height.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of grey icon tiles (4/2/1 per row); each tile toggles its own bullet list in place, red chevron indicator
visualCharacteristics.description: No accordion variants exist. 4 grey icon tiles laid out in a 4-column row (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile); each tile is an independently toggling accordion item whose list expands in place under the tile; red chevron indicator.

contentPattern.summary: 4 grey tiles in a 4-col row: red line icon + bold title + red chevron; each tile is a button that expands its own bulleted list in place (accordion-item, max-height transition)
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: (1) icon image + title text; (2) content (bulleted list)

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for benefit tiles that reveal detail lists. For static tiles use cards-icon; for a stacked FAQ use accordion.
variants.usageDescription: Row of grey icon tiles (4/2/1 per row); each tile toggles its own bullet list in place, red chevron indicator.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Sidebar link tree: blue parent links with a grey chevron toggle on the left that expands/collapses their child links (collapsed by default, animated height); the current page's link is bold dark grey
visualCharacteristics.description: Compact, unboxed rail navigation (source .rail-navigation: 14.4px Gotham, 18px line height, 5px link padding, 18px child indent). accordion-faq (grey question bars, plus icon, two columns) and accordion-icon-grid (icon tiles, shared toggle) do not fit.

contentPattern.summary: 3 parent links (15, 1 and 0 child links); the rail title is a default-content heading before the block
contentPattern.structure: one row per parent item: (1) parent link (`summary`, richtext holding a single link); (2) child links (`text`, richtext bulleted list of links; empty for a plain link without a chevron). The current page is detected at runtime by href

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for sidebar (rail) link trees with collapsible child links. For collapsible FAQ content use accordion-faq.
variants.usageDescription: Sidebar link tree with chevron toggles that expand/collapse child links; highlights the current page.
